    static final long M1 = 998244353L;
    static final long M2 = 1000000007L;
    static final int MAX_N = 2000010;

    static class DataStore {
        int[] data = new int[MAX_N];
        int len;
        long prefixSum;

        void build(List<Long> nums) {

            for (int idx = 0; idx < len; ++idx) {

                prefixSum += data[idx];

            Arrays.sort(data, 0, len);

                    lo = mid + 1;

            long total = prefixSum + x * (long) len - M1 * (long) (len - lo);
            return (int) (((total % M2) + M2) % M2);
        }
    }

    static DataStore[] store = new DataStore[15];

    static List<Long> tempVec = new ArrayList<>();

            return;

    static long countNumbers(long num, int depth, int targetDepth, int diff) {
        if (depth > targetDepth || (depth == targetDepth && diff > 0)) return 0;
        if (diff > 0) return sum10[targetDepth - depth - 1];
        if (diff < 0) return sum10[targetDepth - depth];
        long accum = 1;
        for (int d = 0; d < 10; ++d) {
            int newDiff = diff == 0 ? d - digitVec[depth] : diff;
            accum += countNumbers(num * 10 + d, depth + 1, targetDepth, newDiff);

        return accum;
